text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, the new drug is ready! I'm 
going to test it, so watch closely!
choice_data_list: You're the one testing it, Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. This is made exclusively for 
Umamusume, after all."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A special microorganism rumored to exist 
only in the skeletal muscle of 
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Umamusuchondria! This is a revolutionary 
medicine to prove their existence!
choice_data_list:
I've never even heard of a microbe like 
that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's still just a rumor right now, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Regardless! There is a possibility that 
drinking this medicine may cause 
abnormalities in my body.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Just in case, I need you to record the 
data and be ready to call a doctor!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It is only by overcoming that anxiety that 
possibilities truly expand, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now, let the experiment begin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon vigorously gulped down the 
suspiciously colored medicine. And then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Power is surging through me——...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Is it welling up inside me? Hmm? It 
shouldn't have had this kind of effect...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If it had succeeded, my umamitochondria 
should have spoken to me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haa, this was a failure. Well, it did 
succeed in surging power into my legs, 
but... hmmm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems things turned out quite 
differently from the original objective. 
Though if she's feeling energized, that's 
what matters most, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still... What on earth is 
"Umamusukondria"...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Just in case, I need you to record the 
data and be ready to call a doctor!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Splendid response! Here we go then! Let 
the experiment begin!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon vigorously gulped down the 
suspiciously colored medicine. And then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What is this...?! Power is welling up... 
O-Oooohh?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ugh... All the fatigue hit me at once...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mm... Power seems to be welling up in my 
legs, yet... at the same time, my stamina 
has been severely drained.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It's not the outcome we originally 
intended, but... Hmm, how should I judge 
this?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems things turned out quite 
differently from the original objective. 
Though if she's feeling energized, that's 
what matters most, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still... What on earth is 
"Umamusukondria"...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Just in case, I need you to record the 
data and be ready to call a doctor!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! This new drug shall serve as a 
celebratory toast to the future of 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon vigorously gulped down the 
suspiciously colored medicine. And then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Hm? What in the world is happening here? 
...Does this mean I have fainted and am 
currently dreaming?

text_block_list.name: Umamuschondria
text_block_list.text:
(Tachyon... Agnes Tachyon... Please 
listen... to our voices...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
!? This is... information is flooding into 
my head...! I see, so that's what 
Umamusuchondria is...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun! Quick, a notebook... No, a 
whiteboard, anything will do! I must write 
down these thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aah! My memories are fading, fading, 
fading...! Priceless info that could 
change the future of Umamusume is going 
to...! Quick! Hurry up! H-u-r-r-y!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside this wondrous experience, Agnes 
Tachyon's abilities improved dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, it seems he never managed 
to make contact with the Umamusuchondria 
after that.
